players.detail: Remained out of practice Aug. 18 with a foot issue. No confirmed return has been found, so he remains monitored rather than being assumed available.
Remained out of practice Aug. 18 with an ankle issue after leaving the preseason opener. Green Bay has indicated the issue is not expected to be long-term; no confirmed return has been found.
Did not participate Aug. 18 with a knee issue. No timetable or confirmed return has been reported, so the status remains monitored.
Left the Aug. 18 practice late after being shaken up on a deep pass and later returned to the field without a jersey or helmet. No diagnosis or confirmed limitation has been reported.
Progressed to full 11-on-11 participation this week while working back from knee tendinitis. His workload/role is still being ramped up, but he is no longer being treated as a practice absence.
Returned to team drills Aug. 18 while continuing a managed return from his knee injury. He received first-team work; no new setback has been reported.
Remained on the PUP list through the latest confirmed practice reporting; no activation has been reported.

Remained on PUP through Aug. 18 with a calf issue. GM Brian Gutekunst indicated he could return to practice within roughly the next week, but no activation has been confirmed.
Remained on the PUP list through the latest confirmed practice reporting with a neck issue. No return date is being assumed.
